title: SSOT Registry — blind readings (/reconstruct)
$comment: Built 2026-11-15 for the consumer's /reconstruct gate. A blind reader restates each declaration from its elaborated signature alone; a DIFF-1 item is a place where the file's prose claims more (or other) than the signature says. The consumer's append-only JSONL is the source of truth for a run; this collection is the queryable index of it, keyed so a verdict can bind (path, git_blob_id). Per-item disposition history is kept here as an append-only list so a re-ingest can prove it only ever EXTENDS what was recorded.

brief.$comment: The brief the reader ACTUALLY read. V17/V21 evidence: editing it stales every verdict made under it.

reader_prompt.$comment: The exact prompt bytes handed to the reader, by blob. A scratchpad path alone names nothing that can go stale.

examined.$comment: Every (path, blob) the run examined, stated by the run. NOT inferred from its readings: a file with no declarations (CLAIMS.md) or a run with zero findings would otherwise leave no trace of having been read. Becomes the ledger record's `subjects`.

id.$comment: A reading: deterministic uuid5 of (run_id, path, blob, decl, line). A DIFF-1 item: the caller's item_id, which later disposition lines reference.

key_kind.$comment: registry_id: keyed on the Lean registry's minted id (survives renames). decl_name: a declaration with NO registry entry; needs registry_id_reason. example_line: an anonymous `example`, keyed on (path, blob, line). prose_line: text that is not a declaration at all (a header, a CLAIMS.md row), keyed on (path, blob, line). Checked against the other fields in rules.py, never trusted.

decl.$comment: The qualified name, or a human label for a prose location. A label, never the key.

dispositions.$comment: Append-only. The LAST event is the item's current disposition.
